purpose: Shows why #1618's marker fix cannot be generalised across legend sizes until #1753 lands: office2pdf's own (unfixed) sample-line y already diverges from native past the 9pt case the marker offset was measured at, independent of any marker-floor change. Values in chart points (page pt / 0.82) from mutool draw -F trace on office2pdf's own output, converter built at a3c751b0.
font_substitution_note: office2pdf renders this fixture's Segoe UI legend as Selawik (Microsoft's metric-compatible substitute) on this machine; residual noise below a few hundredths of a point is attributable to that, not to the row-height model itself.
root_cause: line_legend_key's box_height is SERIES_MARKER_SIZE_PT.min(marker_cap), which saturates at SERIES_MARKER_SIZE_PT (5.0pt) once the #1617 marker cap (floor(0.6 x legend_pt)) reaches 5, i.e. every legend size from 9pt up computes the same 5.0pt box_height. Native's row instead scales continuously, matching legend_key_line_box_pt (0.45 x hhea) to within 0.002pt at every size measured (see assets/validation/issue-1617/native-legend-marker-measurements.json's key_height_chart_pt column). Filed as https://github.com/developer0hye/office2pdf/issues/1753.
